sloka: तत्र जातं बहुद्रव्यं धनधान्य मजाविकम् ।ततो वृणीष्व कैकेयि यद्यत्त्वं मनसेच्छसि ॥२-१०-३८॥
transliteration: tatra jātaṁ bahudravyaṁ dhanadhānya majāvikam ।tato vṛṇīṣva kaikeyi yadyattvaṁ manasecchasi ॥2-10-38॥

translations.english: There wealth and foodgrains, sheep and goats and many things are produced. O Kaikeyi, ask whichever of these you wish.
